hero.title:
Describe it.
VOIS builds it.
hero.description: Create your own mini-apps with a single sentence. AI generates the schema, the dashboard, and the voice routing — your business gets tools that no vendor would ever build for you.

steps.label: You describe
steps.prompt: "I want an app to track equipment inspections"

demo.annotation: From one sentence to a working app. No code. No waiting.

benefitCards.title: Voice-routed data
benefitCards.body: Say 'inspected unit 3, compressor showing wear' and it routes to your Equipment Inspections app automatically. Keywords are learned from your schema.

benefitCards.title: AI-powered fields
benefitCards.body: Some fields fill themselves. An 'AI Recommendation' field on your inspection app might generate 'Schedule compressor replacement within 6 months' from your notes.

benefitCards.title: Instant dashboards
benefitCards.body: Every custom app gets charts, filters, and AI insights out of the box. See trends in your data without building anything.

scenario.heading: Real-world scenario
scenario.body: Your cleaning company needs to track site quality scores. You say "create an app for site quality audits." VOIS generates fields for site, auditor, score, photos, and notes. An AI field auto-generates improvement suggestions. Within a minute you have a quality tracking system that routes voice notes from the field directly into structured records.

cta.tagline: Your business is unique. Your tools should be too.
